was: Owned and operated by Denver Water (Denver's municipal water utility); reservations via Campspot. ~56 designated sites around the reservoir, majority RV/trailer-capable (sites cited 30-50 ft, so a 23-ft rig fits); fire ring, picnic table, vault toilets, boat launch; NO drinking water (haul your own) and no hookups. Season ~Apr 1-Nov 30; reservations required via Campspot, $25/night + fee. RV Life 5 star / $$. East Campground: many designated RV sites sit on the open, exposed reservoir shoreline/beach apron (low tree cover); not all sites are on the water. --Claude
note: Run by Denver Water, the city's water utility.  The designated sites ring the reservoir, most of them RV-length (30 to 50 ft), each with a fire ring and picnic table; there is a boat launch.  At the East Campground many RV sites sit on the open, treeless shoreline, though not all are on the water.  Open about April 1 to November 30. --Claude

was: Platte County Agricultural Society fairgrounds with a real ~40-50 full-hookup RV campground (~85 total sites incl. dry), 30/50-amp electric + water + sewer, pull-throughs that fit big rigs (longest reported rig 28 ft; a 23-ft rig fits easily); horse stalls on site. Open seasonally (roughly Oct-June outside fair week, plus fair). Reservable online via Campspot; reviewers also report walk-up/FCFS availability. Dump station, showers, restrooms; ~$20/night. Reviewers note frequent passing trains and a somewhat run-down feel. --Claude
note: Platte County Agricultural Society fairgrounds at Columbus, with 40 to 50 full-hookup sites among about 85 (the rest dry) and horse stalls.  Reviewers mention frequent passing trains and a somewhat run-down feel. --Claude

was: Buffalo County-run (former Ravenna Lake SRA, turned over to the county ~20 yrs ago; NOT a Nebraska Game & Parks SRA despite the old name). 41 RV/tent sites: 8 primitive, 9 electric-only, 16 electric+water, 8 premium electric+water (pull-throughs); 30/50-amp pedestals. Premium pull-throughs fit big rigs. Bathhouse/showers opened spring 2022; dump station on site. Reservable online via Campspot, or drive-up self-pay via iron ranger at the entrance (FCFS sites can fill quickly). No Nebraska state park entry permit required (county area). --Claude
note: Buffalo County park, the former Ravenna Lake State Recreation Area, turned over to the county about 20 years ago, so no Nebraska park permit is needed.  8 primitive sites, 9 electric-only, 16 with water and electric and 8 premium pull-throughs with water and electric; the bathhouse opened in spring 2022.  Walk-up sites are paid at the iron ranger by the entrance and can fill quickly. --Claude

was: City of Gering municipal RV park at the base of Scotts Bluff Nat'l Monument, 585 Five Rocks Rd. 42 concrete pads, most pull-through with full hookups (electric/water/sewer); pads accommodate large rigs (listed up to 65 ft) so a 23-ft Class C fits easily. Open year-round; monthly/28-day rates Nov 1-Mar 31. Showers and laundry in the multipurpose building; dump station (closed Nov 1-May 1). Reservable online via Campspot. --Claude
note: City of Gering RV park at the foot of Scotts Bluff National Monument, with concrete pads and a view of the monument.  Monthly stays are sold only from November 1 to March 31; the dump station is closed November 1 to May 1. --Claude
